candidates.exact_span: If there is no discharge from any outfall during the sampling month, place an "X" in the NO DISCHARGE box located in the upper right corner of the Discharge Monitoring Report.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of when no discharge occurs (sampling month, any outfall) and whether marking the NO DISCHARGE box satisfies the applicable monitoring/reporting obligation affects whether monitoring was required (B) and whether absent numeric results represent a documented no-discharge period versus inadequate evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: If any daily maximum or monthly average value exceeds the effluent limitations specified in Part I. A, the permittee shall report the excursion in accordance with the requirements of Part III. D.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a reported value is evaluated as a daily maximum or monthly average, and whether it is compared against effluent limitations in Part I.A, affects which enforceable numeric limit applies and whether it is exceeded (A); the same exceedance condition also triggers a separate excursion-reporting obligation whose applicability must be evaluated (B).

candidates.exact_span: Any daily maximum or monthly average value reported in the required Discharge Monitoring Report which is in excess of the effluent limitation specified in Part I. A shall constitute evidence of violation of such effluent limitation and of this permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of which reported statistic (daily maximum vs. monthly average), which Part I.A effluent limitation applies, and what counts as 'in excess' directly determines whether a measurement is treated as exceeding an enforceable numeric limit and as violation evidence (A).
